response:
In the context of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988 - Consolidated, an artistic work includes:
    
    1. A graphic work (such as a painting, drawing, diagram, map, chart, plan, engraving, etching, lithograph, woodcut, or similar work).
    2. A photograph (meaning a recording of light or other radiation on any medium from which an image is produced or may be produced).
    3. A sculpture (including a cast or model made for purposes of sculpture).
    4. A work of architecture (being a building or a model for a building, or a part of a building or fixed structure).
    5. A work of artistic craftsmanship.
    
    The Act also provides specific definitions and contexts for these categories, such as how they are recognized as published, what constitutes their copyright, and related rights of the author.
